items.title: Dalton Richards Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: I never did pay too much attention to his style... Walter Pichon was another genius.

ctx.x: Now, are there any other old time piano players, save that period of Steve Lewis, that you might remember anything characteristic of their style? No, just Steve and Joe.
Because they were the only two of Walter. I never did pay too much attention to his style, of course he was coming along at that

time. Walter Pichon? Yeah. Of course he's made quite a few records, too, so we know how he played pretty well. Steve Lewis made a few records, too, with the band, but you can't hear much of him on those records with P-Roll.
